hooks.description: Saves checkpoint and state on graceful stop

orcInternal.description: ORC-specific events triggered internally by the Orchestrator agent during execution

story_start.description: Triggered when a story begins execution

story_complete.description: Triggered when a story completes (success or failure)

story_blocked.description: Triggered when a story is marked as blocked

feature_start.description: Triggered when a feature begins execution

feature_complete.description: Triggered when all stories in a feature complete

epic_start.description: Triggered when an epic begins execution

epic_complete.description: Triggered when all features in an epic complete

deviation_recorded.description: Triggered when a deviation from suggested approach is recorded

checkpoint_saved.description: Triggered when a checkpoint is saved
